description: Tasks retired due to environmental causes (NOT merit-based). The .82+ planner reads this queue and emits respawn tasks with auto-populated prior_failures blocks AND explicit variance per attempt. See openspec/change-proposals/no-permanent-retirement-on-environmental-failures.md for the policy. Per the operator directive (2026-04-29 evening), each respawn applies *deliberate variance* to address a different hypothetical failure cause — pure retry without variance is forbidden.

variance_ladder._doc: Each respawn attempt applies one or more variance dimensions. Order matters: cheaper/smaller variances tried first.

attempt_1.name: tier_escalation
attempt_1.description: Move up the model + max_turns ladder. If Sonnet+30 failed, try Opus+100. If Opus+100 failed, the variance ladder advances to attempt_2 (backend rotation).

attempt_2.name: backend_rotation
attempt_2.description: Switch agent backend (claude → codex / gemini). Different training distribution → different failure modes. Especially relevant for code-heavy tasks where Codex's training corpus may avoid Claude-specific stalls.

attempt_3.name: decomposition
attempt_3.description: Operator-driven: split the experiment into N smaller sub-experiments, each with smaller scope. Surfaced via planner prompt asking for decomposition. Permanent retirement only fires if even the decomposed sub-experiments fail with merit verdicts.

queue.title_stub: Conductor Fastpath Bootstrap Skip + Gate Coercion Fix
queue.diagnosed_root_cause: test_conductor_gates default 50 vs function default 100 (mismatch) + run_agent timeout parameter was dead code (the 60-min env-default applied regardless of caller intent).

to_respawn_1.rationale: Original was already opus+100 — the failure was environmental (test wedge + timeout bug), now fixed in 7a13304d + b2c73a08. Same model/turns is the *minimum* variance for attempt 1. If respawn-1 fails too, attempt 2 escalates to codex (different code-generation distribution + different training corpus may avoid the same stall pattern).

next_attempt_variance_plan.if_respawn_1_fails: attempt_2: agent_type=codex, model=gpt-5.5, max_turns=100 (backend rotation — Codex may handle the multi-step infrastructure work differently)
next_attempt_variance_plan.if_respawn_2_fails: attempt_3: decomposition — split into 3 sub-experiments: (a) bootstrap-skip patch only, (b) gate-coercion logic only, (c) integration test only

queue.title_stub: DualGPU ROCm/CUDA Torch Install + Live Inference v4 — pip install fix
queue.diagnosed_root_cause: Same wedge as exp1039 (test_conductor_gates default mismatch + run_agent timeout dead-code bug). Additionally, the .81 planner set model: opus but max_turns: 25 was too tight even for Opus on hardware-integration tasks (need 100).

to_respawn_1.rationale: Original max_turns=25 was the explicit failure mode (max_turns_FAIL was the first retirement verdict). Attempt 1 quadruples the budget to 100. If still fails at 100 turns, attempt 2 rotates to a more code-corpus-heavy backend (Codex) for the pip-install boilerplate.

next_attempt_variance_plan.if_respawn_1_fails: attempt_2: agent_type=codex, model=gpt-5.5, max_turns=100 (Codex's training corpus has more pip-install + ROCm setup patterns)
next_attempt_variance_plan.if_respawn_2_fails: attempt_3: decomposition — split into (a) torch+ROCm pip install verification, (b) DualGPU detection, (c) live inference smoke test

queue.title_stub: Zenil alpha_t Grounding + Phase-3 AND-Composition k=5 (FR-11 MANDATORY SELF-LEARNING)
queue.diagnosed_root_cause: Sonnet hit max-turns 30 three times consecutively, writing the bootstrap stub on each attempt but never reaching step 5 (FINAL ARTIFACT UPDATE). The Zenil alpha_t + Phase-3 AND-composition work is too complex for 30 turns — same capacity-bound failure mode as exp1028 in .80 milestone. Patches 4975668f / 3d0ef3c1 / 43b19e40 correctly detected the bootstrap-and-bail and refused to log OK; the experiment is retiring honestly rather than wedging the milestone.

to_respawn_1.rationale: All 3 retirement verdicts were 'artifact_not_updated_past_bootstrap' — capacity-bound, not logic-bound. Sonnet+30 wasn't enough to complete the multi-step work. Attempt 1 escalates to Opus+100 (3.3x turn budget + stronger model). The Zenil alpha_t empirical validation is high-priority (validates today's Phase-3 architecture) so worth the Opus quota.

next_attempt_variance_plan.if_respawn_1_fails: attempt_2: agent_type=codex, model=gpt-5.5, max_turns=100 (backend rotation — Codex's training corpus has more JAX/Optax + KAN training implementations; the Zenil+Phase-3 work is heavy on numerical optimization patterns where Codex may handle the artifact-update step more reliably)
next_attempt_variance_plan.if_respawn_2_fails: attempt_3: decomposition — split into (a) alpha_t grounding metric implementation only, (b) Phase-3 AND-composition k=5 wiring only, (c) FR-11 self-learning loop integration only. Each sub-experiment ~50 turns of Sonnet.

queue.priority_note: HIGH — this is the empirical validation of today's 9-round Deep Think Phase-3 architecture chain. The position paper benefits from this experiment landing successfully.

queue.title_stub: Triple Integration E2E v7 — Post Gate Coercion Fix
queue.diagnosed_root_cause: Gated on exp1039.gate_coercion_fixed = true; exp1039 was retired without producing the gate field. exp1044 GATE_BLOCKed indefinitely until commit 4e46ede6 made GATE_BLOCK count toward MAX_FAILURES.

to_respawn_1.rationale: Original failure was 100% gate-dependency (the experiment never actually ran — it gate-blocked before launch). Attempt 1 sequences this AFTER exp1039 respawn produces the gate field. No model variance needed for attempt 1; the variance is the dependency resolution itself.

next_attempt_variance_plan.if_respawn_1_fails: attempt_2: model=opus, max_turns=100 + remove the gate (run unguarded with explicit pre-check) — eliminates the gate-block failure mode entirely while preserving the experiment's actual scope
next_attempt_variance_plan.if_respawn_2_fails: attempt_3: decomposition — split into per-tier integration tests (ThinkPRM-only, SpilledEnergy-only, SC-Energy-only, Ising-only)
